comments.title: Tie-breakers stay ascending whichever way the column sorts
comments.body:
💭 **Assumption** · confidence 0.60 — Tie-breakers stay ascending whichever way the column sorts

**Not taken:** tie-breakers follow the clicked direction, one backward index walk

**Why:** the spec says owners within a city are ordered by name, read as A→Z (openspec/changes/paginate-owners-grid/specs/owner-list/spec.md:56). Nobody asked how a descending city should order its own names; a reviewer reading "descending" as the whole row reversed would be equally right.

comments.title: Seed owner 1 is the add-visit scenario's owner with a pet
comments.body:
💭 **Assumption** · confidence 0.75 — Seed owner 1 is the add-visit scenario's owner with a pet

**Not taken:** take the first pet from GET /api/pets

**Why:** AGENTS.md promises owner 1 = Kevin McCallister to tests, and the DSL fails loudly if he loses his pet. It now books on Kevin every run rather than on whichever owner listed first.

comments.title: The visit-date scenario leaves its own owner behind
comments.body:
💭 **Assumption** · confidence 0.65 — The visit-date scenario leaves its own owner behind

**Not taken:** delete the owner in the After hook with the pet

**Why:** matches add-owner.spec.ts, which leaves its owners on purpose; the After hook already deletes the pet. Pulls down: each run adds one more pet-less owner to the dev database.

comments.title: Add Owner appears twice in the template, not once outside the table
comments.body:
💭 **Assumption** · confidence 0.70 — Add Owner appears twice in the template, not once outside the table

**Not taken:** one footer row outside #ownersTable, paginator shown conditionally inside it

**Why:** the acceptance tests select `#ownersTable mat-paginator`, so the paginator must stay inside the table block; a second button in the empty state keeps that.
